videos.title: Is It Still Too Early to Buy the Dip?
videos.description:
Darius Dale joined Samantha Vadas on Schwab Network's Morning Trade Live to explain why 42 Macro’s systems remain in a risk-off Market Regime, and why the risk of a Q4 2018-style decline remains high.

The driver is less fundamental than behavioral. Funds still modestly up on the year may continue selling to protect those gains, exacerbating the ongoing cascading sequence of degrossing across the global buy side.
